limitations: Single execution 5991de53e82747439e87ba8569667e1b under one bound configuration; no closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool exists (inventory capability_gaps), so none of objective_weighting, seed_or_iteration_plan_selection, horizon_or_deadline_effects or backend_model_mismatch is certified as the dominant settling cause.

The prediction_braking check is a 0.01 s projected-model probe at one saved projected state (model.gvs@1.0.0, implicit Euler, step 0.002) that measures local endpoint differences only; a 10 ms local insensitivity outcome cannot explain a settling failure measured over window_s 0.05 inside the 0.35 s record.

The check's state_scope is the recorded projected GVS state, not the complete backend state; it cannot test backend_model_mismatch, and its own interpretation string states that instantaneous deceleration need not persist during a held-input rollout and that no experimental braking claim is made.

The check outcome is a local-insensitivity (H2) result: with both arms predicting the same local endpoint, objective_weighting, seed_or_iteration_plan_selection, horizon_or_deadline_effects and backend_model_mismatch predict the same local result and remain mutually indistinguishable with these tools in either outcome.

Cost-term importance cannot be ranked: retained recipe weights (terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0, velocity_weight 0.0001, terminal_velocity_weight 0.0001, tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02, tracking_weight 1.0, terminal_weight 5.0, variation_weight 0.001, tension_weight 0.0001) are raw magnitudes without per-term contributions or scaling, and no weight change was adopted by this phase.

Wall-clock timing is not physical feedback delay: deadline_misses 35 with mean_update_s 17.075238151415917 against control_period_s 0.01 are synchronous solve/callback measurements and are not treated here as a physical control-loop delay.

local_comparison is not executable this phase: no per-update effective_horizon value was read, so a saved effective horizon matching horizon_s 0.01 is not confirmed and substituting a different horizon is not permitted; the retained recipe horizon 10 exposes no step-size mapping.

Per-update series for ids other than 34 (measured_initial_state, actual_tension_n, one_step_prediction, optimization_selected_iteration, optimization_raw_status) are retained but were not read within the phase evidence turn limit; control_snapshots.json full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained, and an arbitrary full-trajectory velocity query is not exposed.

The motion view is a sample of the final settling window; absence of a signal in a sampled view is not evidence of absence. max_checks 1 is consumed, the numerical budget used is 2 prediction_evaluations of 24, and no further check is authorized.
recommended_actions: Defer any weight, scale, seed, horizon or deadline change: the saved-state check returned a local-insensitivity (H2) outcome at update 34 and adopted no weight change, so the four candidates still predict the same local result and no dominant settling cause is established.
Report local_comparison as not executable until a per-update effective_horizon value is read and confirmed to match horizon_s 0.01, rather than substituting a different horizon.

Do not attribute the sampled settling failure to either input arm: the braking-box arm's endpoint tip speed was 0.0025478786496899 m/s lower than the recorded arm at 10 ms, within the 0.02 m/s scale, and the source makes no experimental braking claim.
